subject: Staggered backup purge exception + subprocessor evidence sync (Acme Health)
messages:
From: ops-support@acmehealth.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, dpo@healthbridge.com
Date: Wed, 01 May 2029 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Request: backup purge hold and log retention exception for Q2 audit

Hi Neha,

We're approaching an external compliance audit (Q2) and need a temporary hold on a subset of backups and logs for our account (Acme Health). Specifically:

- Forensic logs (security/alerts): hold purge for 60 days
- Application traces (debug/trace): hold purge for 14 days
- S3 snapshots older than 90 days: normal purge (no change)

Can Redwood provide:
1) A short exception timeline and confirmation it will be honored across subprocessors.
2) Subprocessor attestation and list of backups that will be excluded.
3) Any DPA addendum we need to sign and where to send the signed copy.

We attached the audit request summary (Acme_Audit_RQ.pdf). Procurement is copied for PO/charge approvals.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Ops Lead, Acme Health

attachments: Acme_Audit_RQ.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: ops-support@acmehealth.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 11:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Request: backup purge hold and log retention exception for Q2 audit

On Wed, 01 May 2029 at 09:12 ops-support@acmehealth.com wrote:
> We're approaching an external compliance audit (Q2) and need a temporary hold on a subset of backups and logs for our account (Acme Health).

Alex — thanks for the detail and the attachment.

Short answer: we can accommodate a staggered exception. Proposed plan (subject to signed DPA addendum):
- Forensic logs: 60-day hold (captures immediately; purge jobs will skip tagged forensic indices)
- App traces: 14-day hold (applies to trace buckets and ephemeral KV)
- Snapshots: no change as requested

Next steps I need from you:
- Signed DPA addendum (I can send the template or you can sign the attached one)
- Confirmation of the specific account IDs and any subprocessor-specific requirements (e.g., encryption key hold, export logs)

Operational notes:
- We'll create a timebound exception and a manual purge gate. Backup purge job ID: purge-gate-2029-05-02-1. We'll include a log of skipped objects for your audit.
- Subprocessors: we'll request attestation from our storage and backup subprocessor (listed in our DPA annex). Kimberly will coordinate attestation and scope.

I've attached a draft schedule (proposed-purge-schedule.xlsx). Can procurement sign and return the DPA? If you'd rather we route DocuSign, say so and we'll generate the envelope.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

attachments: proposed-purge-schedule.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 08:10:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Staggered exception — subprocessor attestation flow

Neha — I'll pick up subprocessor attestation. Plan:
- Ask primary backup subprocessor (StorCloud) for a written confirmation that the exception will be honored for IDs listed by Acme.
- Obtain signed attestation and a CSV export of excluded object keys for audit.
- Target turnaround 3 business days after we receive Acme's signed DPA addendum.

I'll also confirm cross-border handling — StorCloud's EU cluster will host the excluded snapshots; no egress expected. Will update HubSpot HS-4982 with attestation docs.

-kp

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 May 2029 15:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Staggered exception — operational constraints

Notes on operational constraints:
- We can implement the skip by tagging object prefixes; however, tagging is best-effort for older snapshots — we may need to keep a manual exclude-list for objects older than 120 days.
- Expected impact on storage retention metrics: +0.6% in short term for Acme account.
- Restore window: if Acme requests emergency restore, we'll lift the purge gate for the object(s) only after a signed request from Acme DPO (dpo@healthbridge.com) and an internal approval ticket (SUP-7841).
- Please confirm whether the 60-day forensic hold is calendar days or business days. I've assumed calendar days in the schedule.

I will coordinate with engineering to ensure the purge job ID purge-gate-2029-05-02-1 is immutable for the exception period.

-jw

From: procurement@acmehealth.com
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Thanks — Acme will sign the DPA addendum and procurement attached the signed copy. We agree to the proposed staggered timeline (forensic 60 calendar days; traces 14 calendar days). We also confirm account IDs: acct-acme-1784, acct-acme-1784-eu.

Attachments: Acme_DPA_Addendum_signed.pdf
